name: Lacewing Dragon Nymph
biography: A freshly moulted lacewing dragon, already spinning threads to drag prey off its feet. Habitat: Forest & Jungle.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Stitching Prey
features.description: Some of the dragon's actions cause a hit creature to be threaded. A threaded creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet. A creature stops being threaded when it or a creature within 5 feet of it cuts the threads by hitting them (AC 5) with an attack that deals Slashing damage.

features.name: Web Walker
features.description: The dragon ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing, and it knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The dragon makes one Bite attack and one Needleclaw attack.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

features.name: Needleclaw
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target is threaded (see Stitching Prey trait).

features.name: Silk Shot (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 12 Dexterity, one creature within 15 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Poison damage, and the target is threaded (see Stitching Prey trait). While threaded in this way, the target is Restrained. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Thread Pull
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 12 Strength, one threaded creature within 30 feet. Failure: The target is moved up to 15 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice and knocked Prone. Success: The target is knocked Prone only.
